customItems.name: Contract Shred
customItems.description: A burning clause torn from an infernal contract. It keeps trying to rewrite itself.
customItems.customDescription: A burning clause torn from an infernal contract. It keeps trying to rewrite itself.

intro.text: A local hero signed away six future victories and now cannot win at anything, not even sleep. The contract is held by Blade-Queen Sarthyxa, who values clean clauses more than clean kills.

outro.text: The two contract shreds burn together into a harmless ribbon of smoke. Somewhere above, a cursed hero wins a coin toss and bursts into exhausted tears.

storyTriggers.title: Petition Stair
storyTriggers.text: The stair is paved with rejected pleas. Some are still warm from the hands that wrote them.

storyTriggers.title: Contract Hall
storyTriggers.text: Every table here has a chair on one side and shackles on the other.

storyTriggers.title: Mercy Clause
storyTriggers.text: The first soul cage opens at the forbidden word. A clause curls out, furious at being read by mortals.

storyTriggers.title: Choice Clause
storyTriggers.text: The second cage opens. The shred inside cuts its own signature line to ribbons.

storyTriggers.title: Six Blades Smile
storyTriggers.text: Blade-Queen Sarthyxa smiles with the patience of someone who owns the consequences and has sharpened them.

designNotes.twist: You can complete the contract-breaking objective without requiring a boss kill, though she blocks the dais.
designNotes.revision: Expanded to seven rooms and roughly 5-8 encounter rooms; hidden doors are one-sided from reachable rooms only.
